theme_and_concept.concept: SPEED. ENERGY. COMMUNITY. Less website, more impact.
theme_and_concept.vibe: Extremely modern, spectacular, emotional, fast, memorable. Awwwards-Site-of-the-Day level.

colors.usage_rules: Use #070709 for all main backgrounds. Electric Purple #7C3AED for the ball trail, CTAs, and active hover states. Off-white #F5F5F5 for main typography. Never use generic gradients; rely on dark depth and bright purple/white accents.

scale.hero_h1: text-7xl md:text-9xl lg:text-[12vw] leading-[0.85] tracking-tight uppercase
scale.h2: text-5xl md:text-7xl lg:text-8xl leading-[0.9] tracking-tight uppercase
scale.overline: text-sm md:text-base uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-[#7C3AED] font-manrope font-bold

typography.rules: Headlines must be massive and can span full width on desktop. Use 'leading-[0.85]' or 'leading-none' for Anton. Never center body text. Use minimal 2 fonts. Integrate Google Fonts in index.html or main CSS.

visual_enhancers.signature_element_ball_trail: A dynamic glowing SVG line (Electric Purple #7C3AED) representing a floorball trajectory. Animates on scroll using framer-motion (pathLength). It should cross sections, connect headers to CTAs, and occasionally loop. Add a drop-shadow glow to the SVG path.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use for floating elements (nav, WhatsApp button). backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#070709]/70 border border-white/10. NO fully transparent backgrounds for overlays.
visual_enhancers.cursors: On desktop: hide default cursor, use a custom Framer Motion dot that expands on hover over clickable elements. Add a 'DISCOVER' label inside the cursor on specific editorial images.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity 2-3%) across the entire site to kill digital flatness and enhance the cinematic feel.

grids.asymmetric_editorial: For 'Squadre/Teams', use an asymmetric bento grid on desktop (e.g., spanning different rows/cols) to break monotony. On mobile, this becomes a horizontal swipeable flex container (snap-x).
grids.social_wall: 9:16 aspect ratio grid for Instagram/TikTok reels style video placeholders. Hover reveals a PLAY icon.
grids.general: Start mobile-first (grid-cols-1). Desktop should use 12-column logic with generous empty columns for breathing room.

layouts.hero: 90-100vh. Absolute positioned huge kinetic text. Cinematic background image with a dark overlay (bg-black/40). Bottom CTA 'SCROLL TO PLAY ↓'.
layouts.manifesto: Massive typography section. High contrast. Scroll-triggered text reveal.
layouts.spacing_system: Use huge padding. sections should be py-24 md:py-40. Elements inside sections gap-8 md:gap-16.

motion.global_scroll: MUST use 'lenis' for smooth scrolling to give the 'momentum/speed' feel.
motion.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line reveal for H1 text using Framer Motion initial={y: '100%'} animate={y: 0}.
motion.parallax: Very light vertical parallax on large images. Use framer-motion useScroll and useTransform.
motion.micro_interactions: Image hover zoom (scale-105) inside overflow-hidden wrappers. Button hover: sharp background fill translation. 'Numeri' section MUST use animated counters.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text against dark backgrounds passes WCAG AA. Use text-shadow on hero text if needed.
accessibility.data_testid: ALL interactive elements, forms, and buttons MUST have a descriptive 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., 'data-testid="hero-cta-button"').
accessibility.motion_reduction: Respect prefers-reduced-motion CSS media query or framer-motion setting.

media.style: Dark, cinematic, high contrast, sweaty, raw sports photography. Grayscale with color accents or deeply saturated purple tones.
media.overlays: Always overlay images with a gradient or solid color to ensure text legibility (e.g., bg-black/40 or bg-gradient-to-t from-[#070709] to-transparent).

3d_libraries_and_steps.instructions: AVOID heavy 3D (No Three.js/R3F) as per requirements. Focus purely on ultra-smooth 2D DOM motion, SVG line drawing (Ball Trail), and layout transitions. Add Lenis to the root layout/app component.

hero_cinematic.description: Dynamic hockey player in mid-action with dramatic lighting. Use for the 100vh Hero section.

emotional_crowd.description: Passionate sports fans and flares in a stadium. Use for the Emotional Moment / Manifesto section.

teams_action_1.description: Teenagers facing off in floorball. Use in the Squadre (Teams) editorial grid.

teams_action_2.description: Dynamic moment in roller hockey. Use in the Squadre (Teams) editorial grid.

teams_action_3.description: Action shot of floorball sticks. Use in the Squadre (Teams) editorial grid.

sponsor_abstract_purple.description: Colorful abstract light streaks. Use as a subtle background for the Diamond Sponsor card.

components.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-none) for a brutalist sports feel. Primary: bg-[#7C3AED] text-white hover:bg-white hover:text-black. Include an arrow '→' that translates right on hover.
components.diamond_sponsor_card: Premium exclusive look. Dark background, 1px luminous purple/gold border (border-purple-500/50), subtle inner glow box-shadow. Text: 'LIMITED / 01 AVAILABLE'. CTA: 'PARLIAMONE →'.
components.course_cards: Minimalist. Top border only. Data points (categoria/età/giorni/orari) in small mono or clean sans font. Large CTA to book trial.
components.forms: Dark, sleek. Inputs should have transparent backgrounds, bottom border only (border-white/20) and focus state of border-[#7C3AED]. No generic white boxes.

instructions_to_main_agent.setup: Install 'framer-motion', 'lenis', 'lucide-react'. Set up Tailwind with the custom colors and fonts (Anton, Manrope). Create the basic layout with a dark theme background (#070709).
instructions_to_main_agent.routing: Since it's a 'small website with huge presence', build it primarily as a single-page scrolling experience with distinct, dramatic sections.
instructions_to_main_agent.ball_trail: Implement the 'Ball Trail' as a fixed SVG overlay with pointer-events-none, using Framer Motion's useScroll to draw the path as the user scrolls down.
instructions_to_main_agent.mobile_first: Ensure the layout does not break on mobile. Use horizontal scrolling (overflow-x-auto, snap-x) for the Teams grid and Social wall on small screens.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur). NEVER use completely transparent backgrounds for navs or overlays.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add '.App { text-align: center; }'.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute for testing.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use 'sonner' for toasts if notifications are needed.
Do NOT use TypeScript (.tsx). Generate standard JavaScript React components (.js / .jsx).
sections_blueprint: 1. HERO: 100vh, 'IL FLOORBALL / HA UNA NUOVA / CASA.', mask-reveal typography, cinematic image.
2. MANIFESTO: 'NON È HOCKEY. NON È CALCIO. È FLOORBALL.' Massive typography.
3. CHI SIAMO: 'UNA SQUADRA. UNA COMMUNITY. UN'IDEA GRANDE.'
5. SQUADRE (TEAMS): 'ONE CLUB. MANY STORIES.', asymmetric editorial photo-card grid.
6. GIOCA CON NOI: 'LA TUA PRIMA PARTITA INIZIA QUI.', course cards + TRIAL FORM.
7. EMOTIONAL MOMENT: Full-screen photo, 'UNA COMMUNITY / NON SI GUARDA. / SI VIVE.'
8. SPONSOR: 'PLAY WITH US.', packages BRONZE/SILVER/GOLD/DIAMOND. Diamond card must look exclusive.
10. SOCIAL WALL: 'OFF THE FIELD.', 9:16 reels grid.
11. FINAL CTA: Brand-color background, giant 'READY TO PLAY?', CTA 'PRENOTA UNA PROVA →'.
